notes: Account snapshot: Lodestar Regulatory CodeWorks is a mid-to-large fintech building an internal code assistant for regulated lines (payments, reconciliation). Key ask: enterprise-grade IDE copilot that can run in a private VPC or on-prem bundle with Okta SAML SSO, full audit logging and 7-year retention for code snippets. POC: 6 weeks, 10 engineers, test harness in JetBrains + VS Code plugin. Primary KPIs: interactive completion latency (IDE streaming) p95 < 120ms for single-line completions, end-to-end suggestion quality (reduction in manual search time), and acceptable per-token cost under committed capacity. Model requirements: want ability to pin model versions (no silent upgrades), deterministic routing/fallbacks to a smaller quantized model when capacity constrained, and conservative hallucination controls (system-level prompt constraints + eval hooks). Security notes: Lodestar requires HSM-backed KMS (bring-your-own-key), detailed audit trails (who queried what, full token-level logs retained for 7 years), and proof of SOC2/ISO controls for any hosted components. They prefer VPC with private control plane; on-prem install is a stretch goal for audit teams. "CIO: 'We cannot have a black box changing model behavior without approval'" — strong emphasis on model-version pinning and signed releases. Engineering feedback from demo: streaming looked good but observed spikes at high-concurrency code completion flows (batching behavior needs tuning). SE (Priya) proposed a POC acceptance matrix: latency SLOs, functional correctness on 200 curated prompts, and no PII leakage in suggestions. Procurement: procurement and legal want updated T&Cs for code retention + data processing addendum. Next steps: deliver security questionnaire responses, VPC architecture diagram, and an updated POC statement of work that includes measurable pass/fail criteria. Quick wins: enable SAML + short-term dedicated capacity to lower variance during POC. Sticking points: legal retention language, procurement calendar (closing likely Q2), and confirmation of HSM/KMS integration timeline.
notes_short: Fintech enterprise evaluating Redwood private VPC + IDE streaming POC. Requirements: SAML, KMS/HSM, audit logs, 7y retention, model pinning. POC 6 weeks; blockers: legal retention clause and procurement timing.
